resolution.summary: Published the public GitHub-connected DIP application as https://github.com/vxu-labs/dip-web under Apache-2.0, from a clean standalone checkout at ../dip-web. Audited 12 original private commits; excluded captured DIP history, deployment identity, runtime databases, logs and environment values. Complete new public Git history scan with checksum-verified Gitleaks 8.30.1 returned zero findings. Added professional README, contributor/security guidance, architecture/deployment docs, release notes, attribution, synthetic publication guard tests, pinned CI and secret-scanning workflow. Enabled GitHub secret scanning, push protection, private vulnerability reporting and dependency alerts. Original private checkout and deployed website preserved.
